scope: Matched input components of current PN1 reimplementation and PN2, not a model benchmark
source_range_control: round(0.2 * verified whole-source observed maximum), explicitly counterfactual PN1 rule
secondary_slots: Each box existing dense distinct-point count, matched across all arms
sampling: PN1 native helper functions, independent RNG per box/seed/budget; PN2 nested prefixes of frozen PPS ranking. No historical RNG replay claim.
minimum_foreground_policy: Record whether 256 eligible voxels exist, but do not apply full-pipeline crop scheduling in this point-selection-only comparison. Empty pools are explicit.
duplicate_policy: Keep PN1 native slot sampling, score unique source IDs once, record duplicates; never claim duplicate observations add information.
